_what: The numbers docs/works/air.html is allowed to print, and where each came from. Read by tests/validate_air_quality_page.mjs, which asserts the page's own inline constants equal these — so a guideline value or a demonstration figure cannot be edited on the page alone.

guideline_source.name: WHO global air quality guidelines, 2021
guideline_source.note: The WHO publishes concentrations not to be exceeded over a stated averaging time; it publishes no index. Values below are micrograms per cubic metre.

data_source.name: Open-Meteo Air Quality API
data_source.upstream: Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS) global reanalysis
data_source.note: A gridded model at roughly 11 km, not a single instrument. The current hour, not an average.

demonstration.note: One free API, one hour, seven places, requested by hand before the page was written. Examples, not a ranking.

measured_inconsistency.note: The provider's own particle sub-index (114) contradicts its own particle concentration (1.7 ug/m3) for the same hour on the same scale. Stable across two fetches. Printed on the page as a stated limit; it is the reason the page shows the concentration and the index together rather than the index alone.
